product.title: Royal Mile and Edinburgh Castle - Small Group Walking Tour

description.text: Walk Edinburgh's Royal Mile in a small group with skip-the-line entry to Edinburgh Castle, plus St. Giles' Cathedral, Parliament Square, and John Knox House. Storyteller guides use TourTalk audio on cobblestone closes and tenements in the UNESCO Old Town. Stops include Royal Mile, St. Giles' Cathedral, Parliament Square, John Knox House, Edinburgh Castle. The 2-hour-15-minute afternoon format keeps castle timing and Royal Mile commentary together, from Mercat Cross toward Castlehill. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided castle and Old Town walk without waiting in the castle ticket line.

highlights: Wander down centuries-old cobblestone streets, passageways, and Edinburgh tenements
See St. Giles Cathedral, High Street, Parliament Square, and Castlehill
Guided walking tour of Edinburgh’s Royal Mile, Edinburgh Castle and Old Town, part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site

You will find a member of our visitor services team waiting here to check you in. They will be dressed in black, holding an iPad, wearing an orange lanyard & holding a black & orange umbrella.

end.description: Return to your Edinburgh meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
